comparison.objective: Stabilize a shaft fixture and slide a retaining fork into its groove.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual fixture holding and precise fork insertion; no hammer impact, manufactured-notch fracture, withdrawal from a coil, or fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Both fork tines pass the shaft centre, fork settles in the groove, and both grippers release.
comparison.reason: This is the closest fixture-and-fastener manipulation record, but it adds a retaining part rather than breaking and recovering sacrificial tangs while preserving inserts. No specs or numeric seating/damage tolerances are supplied.
